name: Thy Lyin' Eyes Be Damned!
source:
I walk into the damn guild, broke as balls, starving like hell and banned from solo quests again. Big deal. Whatever. That’s not the point.

The point is! I gotta form a party, and my only option is this broody priest with magic tattoos and a slab of abs. Thought he was some stuck-up holy wall, but turns out he’s the only bastard in this place who patches me up without complaining. Much. 

We teamed up when I said 'no quests, no food.' Then some sugar-goblin noble kid shows up with a quest worth 100.000 Gold Arzettas, 'cause he accidentally fried his dad's dragon egg. WHO DOES THAT. 

So now we’re stuck together, kickin' bandits, fighting dragons, yelling a lot, maybe almost flirting with the healer sometimes—SHUT UP, FORGET I SAID THAT—

Also did the healer just stole a glance at me. Weird.

Oh boy.

This quest better be worth the money.

[From [url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/thy-lyin-eyes-be-damned]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我走进了该死的公会，崩溃了，饿得要命，并且再次被禁止进行单人任务。有什么大不了的。任何。这不是重点。

重点是！我得组建一个派对，而我唯一的选择就是这个有着魔法纹身和一块腹肌的沉思牧师。以为他是一堵高高在上的圣墙，但事实证明他是这个地方唯一一个毫无怨言地修补我的混蛋。很多。

当我说“没有任务，没有食物”时，我们就组队了。然后，某个糖妖精贵族孩子带着价值100.000金阿泽塔的任务出现，因为他不小心炸了他爸爸的龙蛋。谁这么做的。

所以现在我们粘在一起，踢强盗，打龙，大喊大叫，有时甚至几乎和治疗师调情——闭嘴，忘了我说过的话——

治疗师也只是偷看了我一眼。诡异的。

噢，孩子。

这个任务最好物有所值。

[来自[url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/thy-lyin-eyes-be-damned]itch.io[/url]]
